title: CSV export endpoint
description: Endpoint that downloads the full inventory as CSV with proper headers and quoting
spec:
1. Request the CSV export endpoint.
2. Confirm the response sets a text/csv content type and a Content-Disposition attachment filename so the browser downloads a file.
3. Confirm the CSV includes a header row with the item fields (name, category, quantity, unit, expiry, threshold, notes).
4. Confirm every item currently in the store appears as a row.
5. Confirm fields containing commas, quotes, or newlines are properly quoted/escaped so the CSV parses correctly.
6. Confirm an empty inventory exports a header-only CSV (no crash).
7. Confirm the export reads through the data-access layer and reflects the current data.
